title.narrative: Integration of the HIV-AIDS prevention, care and treatment services packet in 239 priority health zones in the Democratic Republic of Congo - Congo (Democratic Republic) (01-Jul-2015-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: Congo (Democratic Republic), HIV, SANRU Asbl (SANRU)This program has the following goals: Contribute to the development of the country by decreasing transmission of HIV in individuals, families and communities (contribute to the decrease of 50% in new infections and mortality) in 354 targeted Health Zones. Ensure global care and treatment of all TB/HIV co-infected patients in DRC. The objectives of this program are: Enrol 95% of TB/HIV co-infected patients on ART by 2017. Reduce from 28.5% to 8% new infections in infants born to HIV positive mothers. Reduce HIV related mortality in adults from 33/100,000 in 2014 to 17/100,000 in 2017
